19239.ins: Chiffon nurse dresses wash on gentle in a bag and dry on a hanger overnight - the drape recovers fully. With three sizes at honest weight bands, this is the listing to order by measurement rather than by the one-size hope that dominates the category.
19239.short: Plus-size chiffon nurse set with dress and matching thong in M, L and XL covering 40-70 kg, as pictured, true size chart.

19255.ins: The rabbit ears headband is wired to hold its shape, so it survives a night of low doorways and leaning - bend it back by hand if travel flattens it. Red polyester photographs warm under party light, which suits the cheongsam palette.
19255.short: Red Christmas cheongsam with rabbit ears and sleeves in polyester oriental cut, M and L sizes for 40-65 kg, holiday styling.

19289.ins: Milk silk is the quiet luxury of this category - the hand-feel reads twice the price, and it does not pill the way cheap costume satin does after a few washes. Hand wash or gentle bag, and the top keeps its shape through the season.
19289.short: Milk-silk secretary set with top, hip skirt and matching thong for office role-play, one size for 40-60 kg, three pieces.

19297.ins: The hat is structured rather than floppy, which is what keeps the uniform read intact through a whole evening - most flight attendant costumes fail exactly there. Blue chiffon travels well: fold, shake out, wear, no ironing required.
19297.short: Blue chiffon flight attendant set with hat, bow tie, dress and thong, one size for 40-60 kg, four-piece uniform costume.

19304.ins: Being genuinely waterproof separates this from costume-grade polyester swimsuits - it works in water, not just near it. Rinse after chlorinated use as with any swim fabric, and the print holds its color through a full season.
19304.short: Waterproof open-crotch one-piece swimsuit in cartoon print, swim-grade fabric, one size for 40-60 kg, as pictured.

19312.ins: Lace bandeaus live and die by the band - this one runs elastic enough to stay put through a night without the strap-digging that cheaper versions inflict. A lingerie bag on gentle keeps the scalloped edges from catching on other wash.
19312.short: Lace secretary set with strapless bandeau, split skirt and matching thong, one size for 40-60 kg, three pieces as pictured.

19320.ins: The bows are sewn rather than clipped, so they survive storage and washing without re-tying. Red chiffon under warm party light reads closest to the product photos - a detail worth knowing if the outfit is being bought for photographs.
19320.short: Red chiffon Christmas dress set with headband, neck ring and matching thong, four pieces, one size for 40-60 kg.

19328.ins: Jumpsuit construction pays off at the end of the night: nothing has ridden up, nothing needs untangling, and the straps have held their line all evening. The lace is delicate enough to want a wash bag but tough enough to survive one.
19328.short: Sheer strap lace nurse jumpsuit with matching thong, one size for 40-60 kg, two-piece costume in as-pictured colorway.

19337.ins: Of the bunny formats on the site, this is the one for long wear - chiffon over a fitted drape, no boning, no hardware pressing anywhere. The neckband is soft-sided rather than structured, which reads the same but sits differently.
19337.short: Chiffon bunny girl lingerie set with headwear, neckband and dress, one size for 40-60 kg, the softest bunny option.

19348.ins: The headgear and neck ring arrive in the same colorway as the jumpsuit, so the maid-bunny hybrid reads as designed rather than assembled. Chiffon jumpsuits wash gently and dry overnight - the open construction means no fastenings to baby.
19348.short: Chiffon maid-bunny jumpsuit with headgear and neck ring in open-crotch cut, one size for 40-60 kg, two themes one piece.
